questions.q: Why did the Most High confound the language at Babel?
choices: They spoke too many languages already
The people being one was not going to produce righteousness; nothing would be restrained from their evil imaginations
They refused to build the tower
questions.explain: There has never been a doctrine of all nations holding hands as one in the scriptures.

questions.q: By what number did the Most High set the bounds of the people (Deuteronomy 32:8)?
choices: The number of the children of Israel
The number of the sons of Noah
questions.explain: The Most High divided the nations their inheritance and separated the sons of Adam; Jacob is His portion.

questions.q: What do the shrinking lifespans in the generations of Shem show?
choices: That the flood changed the calendar
The word of Genesis 6:3 taking hold on man's days
questions.explain: Five hundred years, then four hundred, then two hundred, then down past one hundred and nineteen with Nahor.

questions.q: What does it mean that Lot was a just man?
choices: He was a judge of Sodom
He did that which is lawful and right: a commandment keeper
questions.explain: A just man is one that does that which is lawful and right (Ezekiel 18:5); righteous Lot was vexed by the wicked (2 Peter 2:7-9).
